name: format-currency
summary: Format a numeric amount as a currency display string, with correct decimal places and symbol placement for a disclosed, finite set of currency/locale combinations.
description: Formats amount as a currency string using currency_code's standard minor-unit decimal places and locale's symbol-placement convention, both drawn from a small fixed, disclosed table covering exactly 8 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, INR, BHD) and 5 locales (en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP) -- not a live ISO 4217 registry and not full ICU/CLDR data; see SPEC.md for the exact table. An unrecognized currency_code or locale falls back to a generic '<CODE> <amount>' format rather than guessing, and supported: false is returned so the caller can detect the fallback rather than silently trusting an unstyled result. Negative amounts are formatted with a leading minus sign before the symbol (e.g. '-$12.50'), not locale-specific parenthetical negative notation, in this version.

preconditions.description: The caller provides a finite numeric amount and an ISO 4217 currency_code string.

postconditions.description: formatted is always a non-empty string, even for an unsupported currency_code/locale (generic '<CODE> <amount>' fallback rather than an error).
supported: false whenever either currency_code or locale fell outside this version's disclosed lookup tables and the generic fallback format was used.

side_effects.description: Produces one formatted string derived from the provided amount/currency_code/locale.
